attempts.answer: A Large Language Model (LLM) is a type of artificial intelligence program designed to read, write, and understand human language. It works as an advanced statistical prediction machine, processing text by breaking it down into small pieces and repeatedly guessing the most likely next word in a sequence using deep learning and neural networks.
attempts.question: What is an LLM, and how does it work?

attempts.answer: The transformer architecture is a deep learning design introduced in the 2017 paper "Attention Is All You Need". It processes entire sequences of data in parallel using self-attention mechanisms rather than step-by-step loops, powering modern AI systems like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Llama

attempts.answer: Attention is a computer brain method. It lets a model focus on important parts of data while ignoring the rest. Self-attention is a special type of attention. It lets every word in a single sentence look at all other words in that same sentence to understand context.

attempts.answer: GPT, Llama, and Claude are leading large language models created by different organizations. GPT (by OpenAI) is a versatile, closed-source generalist model; Claude (by Anthropic) prioritizes safety, complex reasoning, and coding; and Llama (by Meta) is an open-source model designed for local customization and cost efficiency
